exposure: antepartum hospital admissions (>72 hours in previous 30 days)
cohort: The study included 120,235 deliveries from patients presenting for obstetric or postpartum care between January 2016 and March 2018.
finding: Expanding pharmacologic prophylaxis to include antepartum admissions >72 hours and those with age and BMI >=35 undergoing cesarean delivery could reduce total VTE events by approximately one-third.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery, particularly when combined with age and BMI >=35, is identified as a high-risk factor for VTE.
